name: Polymarket BTC tie-rule context
description: Consumes the bound Polymarket market's rules-card tie outcome and its standardized moneyness. tie_outcome is normalized to the canonical up/down/void vocabulary (Polymarket up maps to up; a future venue vocabulary must extend the mapping). near_tie is true when the absolute moneyness is at or within near_tie_threshold. tie_advantage_side is the tie outcome when near a tie and the tie is not a void, otherwise none. Not ready until both inputs have been seen. near_tie_threshold defaults to 0.1. Decimal outputs are rounded to eight places using round-half-to-even.
